text:
Alex: Quick async — final launch triage for tomorrow's release (v1.2). Share what you did / blockers / plan for today. Keeping it short pls.

Mina: Did the QA pass on routing changes; found two edge-case failures for long prompts, created ticket PROD-483. Blocker: need model pins for canary to test fallback.

Jamal: Merged PR #842 (batching config). Smoke tested on staging, latency looks good. No blockers from infra. @DevOps Bot can we get a dedicated canary instance quota for 2 hours tomorrow morning?

DevOps Bot: @Jamal noted — created request RQ-229, pending approval from @Lara. ETA ~30m for quota confirmation.

Sophie: UX done on rollout banner and back-compat copy. Two notes: (1) default banner text needs legal approval, (2) the banner overlaps with mobile nav on small screens — will push a CSS fix by EOD.

Lara: Approving quota now. @DevOps Bot please escalate if any dependency on cloud quotas.

ProductOps: Scheduling canary at 09:30 PT. Plan: 10% traffic -> 50% -> full if green over 30m. Will run canary regression set A then B.

Mina: For the prompt-edge failures, temporary mitigation is to shorten max tokens for those routes. I can patch today, but that will change cost. Suggest doing if canary shows no regressions.

Jamal: Agree. We'll monitor token distribution during canary and revert if cost spikes. I can add alert for QPS/token-per-request.

Sophie: Legal is reviewing copy, should be done by 4pm. If delayed, we'll deploy with generic wording and update after signoff.

Alex: Action items — @Jamal follow up on quota & alerting; @Mina prepare a short mitigation PR; @Sophie standby for CSS patch + copy fallback; @Lara expedite quota approval. Everyone react with :thumbsup: if good.

Lara: Thumbs up, ramping approval. (reacted :thumbsup:)

Mina: Will open PR in 20m and add tests.

Jamal: Quota approved by infra, canary slot reserved. I'll post the canary playbook in #incidents 30m before start.

ProductOps: Noted — I'll post the schedule and checklist.

Alex: Cool. If anything blocks that affects launch timing >30m, flag here ASAP. Otherwise we'll proceed with the morning canary. :rocket:
